basis.governing_question: Why do property and health claims take too long to settle, and what claims operating model should Atlântico Seguros move to?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish where and why property and health claims settle slowly, and how satisfaction stands today.

gate.label: Findings sign-off
gate.decision: Do the diagnostic findings stand as the basis for designing the target model?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the claims operating model for property and health claims and the roadmap to reach it.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Does the Board approve the recommended claims operating model and roadmap?

workstreams.name: Settlement time baseline
workstreams.answers: How long do property and health claims take to settle, and where does the time go?
activities: Extract settlement times from operational claims data
Compare property and health with motor claims since 2024
Break down elapsed time by handling step

workstreams.name: Handling pain points
workstreams.answers: What do the people who handle property and health claims see slowing settlement?
activities: Interview claims handlers and team leads who do the work
Interview the COO and the Head of Claims on known causes
Review claims handling procedures and guidelines

workstreams.name: Satisfaction baseline
workstreams.answers: What is customer satisfaction on property and health claims today, and what shapes it?
activities: Review satisfaction results for property and health claims
Interview recently settled claimants about the process

workstreams.name: Delay causes and priorities
workstreams.answers: Which causes explain the delay in property and health claims, and which matter most?
activities: Test delay hypotheses against data and interview findings
Assess why the 2024 lean program did not reach these claims
Rank causes by effect on settlement time

workstreams.name: Target model options
workstreams.answers: Which claims operating models could settle property and health claims faster without hurting satisfaction?
activities: Define options for handling property and health claims
Keep every option within the current claims IT system
Compare options on settlement time and satisfaction

workstreams.name: Detailed model design
workstreams.answers: How would the chosen model work in roles, process steps and handoffs for property and health claims?
activities: Detail roles, steps and handoffs of the chosen model
Estimate the effect on settlement time with claims data
Check the design against the satisfaction criterion

workstreams.name: Recommendations and report
workstreams.answers: What should the Board decide on the claims operating model, and what evidence supports it?
activities: Draft the written report with findings and recommendations
Prepare the board presentation of the recommendations
Test the answer against both success criteria

deliverables.name: Settlement time baseline by claim type
Interview synthesis of handling pain points
Customer satisfaction baseline by claim type
Claims operating model options compared on criteria
Detailed design of the chosen model

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on scope, data access and plan
events.decision: Does the steering group confirm the scope and the plan of work?
agenda: Present the plan of work and the two phases
Align on data access and the interview schedule
Confirm steering group members and meeting dates

events.label: Workshop 1: first findings
events.decision: Which delay causes should the remaining diagnostic work prioritize?
agenda: Present settlement time and satisfaction baselines
Review pain points raised in interviews
Align on which delay causes to prioritize

events.label: Findings sign-off
events.decision: Do the diagnostic findings stand as the basis for designing the target model?
agenda: Present the ranked causes of settlement delay
Decide whether the findings anchor the design phase

events.label: Workshop 2: model options
events.purpose: Review options and choose one to detail
events.decision: Which claims operating model option should be detailed for the recommendation?
agenda: Present the options compared on the agreed criteria
Discuss fit with the settlement time and satisfaction criteria

events.label: Final readout
events.decision: Does the Board approve the recommended claims operating model and roadmap?
agenda: Present the written report and the board presentation
Review the detailed design and the roadmap
Decide on the recommended claims operating model

deadline.text: Recommendations presented to the Board on March 15, 2027

architect_notes: Engagement length is not given; the 14 to 18 weeks are an estimate from archetype lengths, within the 19 weeks available.
Not covered by the phases: ASF, new supervisor guidance on claims-handling response times. Confirm whether it is in scope.
Rollout of the chosen model is not in these phases because the brief asks for a diagnostic and recommendation, not implementation support.
